name: Chart-pattern family: Heikin-Ashi, FRVP, VWAP, FVG, order block, liquidity sweep, Fibonacci, Elliott, RSI/EMA
one_line: 10 TJR/ICT-style signals approximated on daily bars; only Heikin-Ashi and FRVP passed baseline, all later rejected.

source.license: no LICENSE file in repo; owner's own repository (owner-provided reference, do not redistribute)

idea: Approximate popular chart-pattern concepts with daily OHLCV rules (Heikin-Ashi colour runs, fixed-range volume profile, VWAP reclaim, fair-value gaps, order blocks, liquidity sweeps, Fibonacci retracements, Elliott counts, RSI/EMA).
rationale: Owner-supplied ideas from TJR/ICT videos tested systematically.
evidence: Heikin-Ashi base CAGR 71.3%/MDD 72.2%; +25% circuit-breaker + BTC-resume 129%/52.9% (later rejected: flapping 92-96%). FRVP 67.5/73.1. VWAP 108/87. Others 0-45% with MDD 55-86%.
limitations: variants selected on same sample (53 combos for R3 winner)
mostly lose to BTC in recent 2 years

pipeline_fit.notes: Use only as negative evidence: drawdown-heavy; do not propose without a drawdown control that is itself tested.
